meta.description: Hand-curated, significance-based candidate list for the Events & Inventions lane redesign. Not a SPARQL dump like the sibling events-*.raw.json files — inventions.ts's P575-only fetch produced no usable classification signal, so this lane's selection and categorization is curated by hand and verified against live Wikidata per item, then filtered: noise/duplicate/off-scope entries and events before 5000 BCE removed, category assigned to the new 10-value taxonomy (replacing the shared Category enum).

fields.name: event label
fields.dateProperty: Wikidata property that supplied the date (P575 time of discovery/invention, P571 inception, P577 publication date, P580 start time, P585 point in time, P569 date of birth, P606 first flight, P619 spacecraft launch date, P729 service entry, P1619 date of official opening)
fields.source: seed = hand-picked and verified; scraped = surfaced via filtered Wikipedia timeline scraping, then verified
